title: l2_key_selection host suite broken on main: lichen_link_rx.c uses CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC-gated schc_failures unconditionally
description: Found verifying cdfb. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_rx.c:365-391 uses ctx->schc_failures and calls lichen_schc_failure_record()/lichen_schc_failure_clear() with no config guard (0 '#ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC' in the file), but the struct member lichen_link_rx_ctx::schc_failures is gated behind '#ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC' in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/include/lichen/link.h:451-453, and no host suite defines CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC. Result: any host suite compiling lichen_link_rx.c fails — l2_key_selection: 'struct lichen_link_rx_ctx has no member named schc_failures' + implicit decl of lichen_schc_failure_record/clear (-Werror). Broken since 1839a4279d 'fix(link): rx failure accounting keyed on peer pubkey' (2026-09-04). Repro: cmake -S lichen/tests/l2_key_selection -B build && cmake --build build (gcc-13). Fix options: (a) guard the schc_failures uses in lichen_link_rx.c with the same CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC ifdef as the header (matches gating intent; the peer_pubkey NULL-check pattern already handles absence), or (b) define CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC in the affected host suites (broader compile surface). Audit whether other host suites compiling lichen_link_rx.c are similarly broken.
close_reason: Fixed: guarded the two schc_failures uses in lichen_link_rx.c with '#ifdef CONFIG_LICHEN_SCHC' (matching the gating of the rx-ctx member in link.h:451-453, the embedded tracker in link_ctx.h:117-118, and the init in link_ctx.c:210-215). When the macro is undefined the failure path is unchanged (ret=-EINVAL; goto cleanup) and the success path is unchanged (ret=0); when defined, preprocessed output is byte-identical to before (verified by gcc -E). Verification: l2_key_selection host suite builds and passes 1/1 under ASan/UBSan with gcc-13. Audit of other host suites: link_crypto, link_relay, ping_l2 only reference lichen_link_rx.c in test mains (do not compile it), so none are broken. 3x delegated kimi-k3 reviews (correctness/security/edge): all PASS, zero findings.
